H.R. 5256, 340B ACCESS Act, bill status (GovInfo BILLSTATUS XML)

status_summary: No 340B statute has been enacted. H.R. 5256, the 340B ACCESS Act, was introduced on 2025-09-10 and referred to Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means, with no later action recorded; it would define eligible patients, require sliding-fee patient discounts at hospital covered entities, add covered entity data submissions and set civil penalties. A bipartisan Senate group introduced the SUSTAIN 340B Act on 2026-08-05, with annual reporting and a patient financial assistance policy, according to a trade journal. Separately, HRSA's voluntary rebate model pilot (notice of 2025-08-01) was preliminarily enjoined by the District of Maine on 2025-12-29 and vacated and remanded on 2026-02-10; HRSA issued a request for information on 2026-02-17 and a revised pilot notice on 2026-08-03 with a 2027-01-01 start.

timeline.event: HRSA publishes the application process for the 340B Rebate Model Pilot Program.

The District of Maine grants a preliminary injunction in American Hospital Association v. Kennedy, pausing the rebate pilot before its planned 2026-01-01 start (as stated in the 2026-08-03 HRSA notice).
Court vacates and remands the 2025 pilot approvals on the parties' joint motion.
HRSA issues a request for information on the 340B rebate pilot.
HRSA publishes a notice revising the pilot, with manufacturer plans due 2026-08-24 and a 2027-01-01 earliest start.
A bipartisan group of senators introduces the SUSTAIN 340B Act, with annual covered entity reporting and a patient financial assistance policy.
